title: The Ship Going the Other Way
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler of courage, and tonight the whole lesson is one brave turn: Jonah had the dread of a hard job and ran for the ship, and Beau, with crumbs everywhere and his feet wanting the hallway, found the little broom instead.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because it takes courage to walk toward a hard job instead of running from it. In Beau’s world today: Beau knocked over the cracker box, and crumbs went everywhere. His feet wanted to run down the hallway, but he found the little broom instead. Mom came in and found him sweeping. Just like Jonah could not sail away from Heavenly Father, Beau learned that turning around is braver than running.
